tbesh_html:
Kir-hareseth or Kir-hares or Kir-haresh = "wall of potsherds"
one of the two chief strongholds of Moab
Another name of qir (קִיר "Kir" H7024B)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Kir-Cheres or Kir-Chareseth, a place in Moab
strongs_1890.derivation: or (feminine of the latter word) קִיר חֲרֶשֶׂת; from H7023 (קִיר) and H2789 (חֶרֶשׂ); fortress of earthenware;
